items.authored_reason: All finite-N gaps and the analytic line are generated from Eq. (1); the unpublished point grid is explicitly reconstructed.
The complete first 500 levels at N=5000 are generated, with every eighth rendered.
Both invariant blocks are implemented exactly.
Coordinate map, bracket, and saddle are independently derived.
Minima and ground-energy asymptote are checked against exact N=5000 numerics.
Normal and deformed low-energy gaps are reproduced.
Exact level spacings test the WKB density-of-states claim.
The saddle-energy logarithmic level-spacing law is computed independently.
The excitation energy from the ground state to the separatrix threshold is evaluated independently.
The critical k^(4/3) excitation-index exponent is fitted from independent exact spectra.
The critical N^(-1/3) finite-size exponent is fitted from independent exact spectra.
Exact cross-parity splittings are tested for exponential N decay.

items.source_ref: Super-scarring paragraph before Fig. 2, WKB transition statements
items.authored_reason: The separatrix action and all three quoted super-scar transition indices are computed independently.
Every same-parity gap is binned across both full bands, with the rising lower-energy branch separated from the returning upper branch.
The printed operator identity is derived; no numerical wavefunction target is published.
Two explicit self-adjoint orderings are compared against Eq. (1) over six N values, both parity sectors, and four couplings; the missing author prescription stays explicit.
Complex characteristic double roots are solved at six increasing particle numbers and their distance to lambda=1 is frozen.
Near-real finite-N roots are stratified by distance to the symmetry-related separatrix energies.
The same root inventory reports near-real roots below lambda=1 and above lambda=1 away from the separatrix; no absence is inferred from a failed search.
